resources.string: An offline map of the world. Download a region once, then search, find a route and follow it by car, on foot or by bike with no connection. Drawn for an E Ink screen: black on white, nothing that moves.

Your position, searches, routes, favorites and tracks stay on this phone; nothing about you is collected and there is no account. The network is used to download and update the maps you choose, from the CoMaps map servers, which see your internet address and which regions you fetch, as any download does. On a phone that has Google Play services, the Google Fused Location Service switch (Settings, Privacy) lets Google\'s location service help find your position, and that may contact Google; switched off, only the phone\'s own positioning is used. A link you press opens in your browser.
Atlas is free software and comes with no warranty: use it at your own risk. Maps can be wrong or out of date, and a route is a suggestion. The road, its signs and your own judgment come first.
Atlas is CoMaps in house dress: the map engine, search and routing are the work of the CoMaps, Organic Maps and MAPS.ME contributors. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

This app is made by wander wildwood, an independent developer: one person, not a company. That makes wander wildwood the data controller for anything the app itself handles, and that is very little: what you put in stays on this phone unless you send it somewhere yourself, or the app sends it to the CoMaps map servers as described above, and nothing comes to the developer.
Write to email@wanderthe.dev, about your data or anything else.

Under the GDPR you can ask to see the data held about you, to have it corrected or deleted, to limit or object to its use, to take a copy with you, to withdraw consent, and to complain to a data protection authority. Since the app keeps what it stores only on your phone, you can do most of this yourself: delete favorites, tracks and downloaded maps in the app, clear the app\'s data in Android\'s settings, or uninstall the app. What the CoMaps map servers receive is covered by their own privacy policy.
